card.name: Can't reply: contact-page disclaimers
card.fires_on: The 't or ’t after "can" in website notes saying the author cannot reply personally to every message. It also fires weakly on digits inside long numbers and on crawler/search-engine wording.

modes.label: Can't reply notes
modes.description: The contraction 't after "can" in a sentence about being unable to answer reader mail.
modes.example: Although we can<<'t>> reply personally, you may see your question

modes.label: Digits in long strings
modes.description: A single digit inside a timestamp, ISBN or password-like string.
modes.example: Tue, 30 Oct 2012, 11:07:1<<1>> EDT - How Martian winds make rocks

modes.label: Search crawler text
modes.description: Words about web crawlers and indexing in explanations of how search engines work.
modes.example: use craw<<lers>> to find pages for their algorithmic search

card.plain: It lights up on the "'t" in "can't reply" notes on web contact pages, and a little on digits in long codes.
